items.title: Six In-Game Radio Stations Revealed
items.description:
Rockstar has detailed six of the stations broadcasting across Leonida, from what it calls the biggest and widest-ranging in-game radio selection in the series:

• Cocoteo FM — modern Latin music, from bachata and merengue to dembow and reggaeton, hosted by El Martillo and La Gata
• Back Country Radio — renegade country with MW and Delta Dawne, plus roving reporter Mud Dog Mike out in the Grassrivers
• AfroBank FM — African music from 20th-century classics to amapiano and 3-step, with Burna and Palmsy
• The Chamber 106.6 — decades of metal with DJ Kerry and DJ Tom
• Flash FM — the Vice City pop institution, with Robyn and Alex
• Dirty South Classics — regional rap and hip-hop classics from Trick and Trina

For the first time in the series there are also on-demand podcasts. Jason and Lucia can listen to radio and podcasts in vehicles or on foot, through headphones and earbuds connected to their phones.

Previews of all six stations are on the Music page of the official GTA VI site.
items.author: Rockstar Games Newswire
items.summary: Cocoteo FM, Back Country Radio, AfroBank FM, The Chamber 106.6, Flash FM and Dirty South Classics — plus on-demand podcasts, a series first.

items.title: GTA VI Apparel and Collectibles Now at the Rockstar Store
items.description:
The official Grand Theft Auto VI Collection is now available exclusively at the Rockstar Store. The first wave includes:

• Heavyweight tees in black, blue and pink with the VI logo or the classic Rockstar Games logo
• Goodtime State and Macca the Gator tees, inspired by the styles Jason and Lucia wear in the Ultimate Edition
• Flexfit caps with palm trees inside the VI logo, plus the original Rockstar cap in GTA VI colors (pre-order)
• A chrome keychain, a two-sided Vice City money clip and a refillable Vice City Zippo lighter
• Canvas tote bags and two sets of vinyl stickers

Rockstar says more items are on the way. The store also has a new wishlist feature, with restock and sale alerts for Rockstar mailing list subscribers.
items.author: Rockstar Games Newswire
items.summary: Tees, caps, a Vice City money clip, a Zippo lighter and more — the first wave of official GTA VI merch is live.

items.title: The Goodtime State – Vice City Collector's Box Is Up for Pre-Order
items.description:
Grand Theft Auto VI: The Goodtime State – Vice City Collection is a limited-edition collector's box themed around Macca the Gator, Leonida's hit TV show. It arrives November 19 and can be pre-ordered while supplies last. Inside:

• 6-inch Macca the Gator figure with a stash compartment
• Matte black GTA VI Oakley Frogskins sunglasses with Prizm Sapphire lenses
• New Era 9FORTY A-Frame snapback with Vice City Leonida details
• Macca the Gator magnetic mirror
• Vice City swizzle spoon
• Vice City razor blade keychain
• Leonida Keys crossbody bag
• Chunkee the Manatee shot glass
• Leonida Keys enamel pin set in a metal tin
• Premium stickers in a stash bag
• Double-sided souvenir poster of the full Leonida landscape

The game is sold separately. Pre-orders are open at store.rockstargames.com, and Rockstar will share details for Asia, Latin America and Australia later.
items.author: Rockstar Games Newswire
items.summary: A limited Macca the Gator collector's box — figure, Oakley sunglasses, a Leonida poster and more — arrives November 19.

items.title: GTA VI: The Album — 34 Original Tracks Arrive November 19
items.description:
Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album, the official soundtrack album made with Atlantic Records, launches November 19 alongside the game. It has 34 original tracks and can be pre-saved on all major streaming services, with vinyl and CD editions up for pre-order.

Six singles came out with the announcement:
• Yung Lean — That's It (feat. Future & Metro Boomin)
• Travis Scott — RHYNO (prod. by Guy-Manuel de Homem-Christo)
• CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso, PinkPantheress, Fred again.. & Etienne de Crécy — Sexy Magic
• Morgan Wallen — Last Thing You Need
• Rauw Alejandro — Macacoa 2000
• Keith Richards — Bright Lights, Big City

Two more singles are now listed on the official Music page: Fuerza Regida — Suzuki, and Cardi B — Don't Chart.

Three physical exclusives are sold only at gtavi-thealbum.com: a limited liquid-filled vinyl, a splatter vinyl and a CD jewel case. Retailers including Best Buy, Walmart, Amazon, Target and Urban Outfitters carry their own vinyl colorways.
items.author: Rockstar Games Newswire
items.summary: 34 original tracks with Atlantic Records, out November 19. Eight singles are already streaming, from Travis Scott to Keith Richards.

items.title: GTA VI: An Extended Look Is Out Now
items.description:
Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look premiered on Netflix on August 27 and is now on the Rockstar Games YouTube channel and the official GTA VI site.

Everything in it was captured from in-game footage on PlayStation 5. Rockstar calls it the biggest, most immersive evolution of the series yet.

Tap to watch it on YouTube.
items.author: Rockstar Games
items.summary: Captured entirely in-game on PS5 — the first new footage since Trailer 2 is now on YouTube and the official site.

items.title: GTA VI: An Extended Look Premieres August 27 on Netflix
items.description:
Rockstar Games announced Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look, the first new footage since Trailer 2. It premieres on Netflix on Thursday, August 27 at 3 PM ET, then launches on the Rockstar Games YouTube channel and the official GTA VI site at 9 PM ET the same day.

Netflix subscribers get the presentation six hours before the worldwide YouTube release.
items.author: Rockstar Games Newswire
items.summary: An Extended Look at Grand Theft Auto VI debuts August 27 — Netflix at 3 PM ET, then YouTube and the GTA VI site at 9 PM ET.

items.title: November 19 Launch Locked In
items.description: Take-Two Interactive has repeatedly reaffirmed the November 19, 2026 launch date across its 2026 investor updates, with CEO Strauss Zelnick tying record fiscal-year projections to the release. The company says the game remains on schedule, and no further delays are planned.
items.author: Take-Two Interactive
items.summary: Take-Two keeps reaffirming November 19, 2026 in earnings updates — the date is locked and no further delays are planned.

items.title: Physical Editions Arrive November 12 for Preloading
items.description: Physical copies of Grand Theft Auto VI reach retail on November 12, one week before launch. The box contains a download code rather than a disc, so players can install and preload the game's large download ahead of the November 19 release.
items.author: Rockstar Games
items.summary: Physical editions hit shelves November 12 with a download code inside, giving players a week to install and preload before launch.

items.title: The Sound of Leonida: Every Song Confirmed So Far
items.description:
Six licensed tracks have been heard across Rockstar's official trailers and site videos: Love Is a Long Road by Tom Petty (Trailer 1), Hot Together by The Pointer Sisters (Trailer 2), Everybody Have Fun Tonight by Wang Chung, Talkin' to Myself Again by Tammy Wynette, Thunder Island by Jay Ferguson, and Child Support by Zenglen.

Since then Rockstar has revealed much more. Six in-game radio stations are confirmed — Cocoteo FM, Back Country Radio, AfroBank FM, The Chamber 106.6, Flash FM and Dirty South Classics — along with on-demand podcasts. GTA VI: The Album, an official soundtrack of 34 original tracks, arrives November 19, and eight of its singles are already out.

The full station list and the game's dynamic score are still to be detailed.
items.author: ViceBase Research
items.summary: Six trailer songs, six confirmed radio stations and an official 34-track album. The full station list is still to come.

items.title: PS5 Features Confirmed: 3D Audio, Haptics, Near-Instant Loads
items.description:
The official PlayStation product page, linked from Rockstar's GTA VI site, confirms platform features: near-instant load times via the PS5 SSD, Tempest 3D Audio positioning, and full DualSense support — haptic feedback that reacts to your choices and environment, adaptive trigger resistance, and effects through the controller speaker.

The store listing describes Grand Theft Auto VI as a single-player experience.
items.author: PlayStation
items.summary: Official PS5 feature list: near-instant SSD loading, Tempest 3D Audio, DualSense haptics, adaptive triggers, and controller speaker effects.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Launches November 19, 2026
items.description: Rockstar Games has confirmed that Grand Theft Auto VI will launch worldwide on Thursday, November 19, 2026 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Announcing the move from the previous May 26, 2026 date, Rockstar said the extra months would allow the team to finish the game with the level of polish players have come to expect.
items.author: Rockstar Games Newswire
items.summary: The final confirmed worldwide launch date for Grand Theft Auto VI is November 19, 2026, on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

items.title: Standard and Ultimate Editions Detailed
items.description: Grand Theft Auto VI is available in two editions. The Standard Edition includes the full game and is sold digitally and as a physical release. The Ultimate Edition is digital only and adds premium vehicles, personalised weapons, exclusive apparel and tattoos, and Ultimate-only businesses threaded through the story. Every pre-order placed before November 20, 2026 also includes the Vintage Vice City Pack.
items.author: Rockstar Games Newswire
items.summary: Standard Edition USD 79.99, Ultimate Edition USD 99.99 (digital only). Pre-orders before November 20, 2026 include the Vintage Vice City Pack.

items.title: Vintage Vice City Pre-Order Pack
items.description:
Welcome back to Vice City.

Featuring a timeless ’55 Vapid Stanier sedan and garage alongside Ocean Beach, decadent outfits and hairstyles for both Jason and Lucia, and an iconic weapon pattern that echoes the excess of the past.
items.author: Rockstar Games Newswire
items.summary: Secure exclusive in-game items including the '55 Vapid Stanier sedan, Shore Court garage, retro curls and sequin dress, and a tropical weapon pattern.

items.title: Ultimate Edition Content Details
items.description:
Welcome to Leonida, the state where anything goes. Seize everything this massive world has to offer with the Grand Theft Auto VI: Ultimate Edition, an exclusive collection of premium vehicles, weapons, apparel, and action around every corner.

Ultimate Edition bonuses are threaded across all aspects of Jason and Lucia’s story, with new items uncovered behind each chapter.
items.author: Rockstar Games Newswire
items.summary: Details of the GTA VI Ultimate Edition, including the '95 Grotti Cheetah, Shitzu Squalo, '67 Vapid Dominator Buggy, Rideout Customs and Sara's Unisex Salon.

items.title: Official Cover Art and Logo Revealed
items.description: Rockstar Games revealed the official cover art and updated logo for Grand Theft Auto VI, ahead of pre-orders opening the following week.
items.author: Rockstar Games Newswire
items.summary: Rockstar Games unveils the Grand Theft Auto VI cover art and refreshed series logo.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Official Trailer 2 Out Now
items.description: Watch the second official trailer for Grand Theft Auto VI. Get a closer look at the state of Leonida, the relationship between Jason and Lucia, and the supporting cast running the crime-ridden streets of Vice City.
items.author: Rockstar Games Newswire
items.summary: The second official trailer for GTA VI, showing more of Leonida and the game's supporting cast.

items.title: Release Date Moved to May 26, 2026
items.description: Rockstar Games announced that Grand Theft Auto VI would move out of its 2025 window to May 26, 2026. The date was later revised again to November 19, 2026.
items.author: Rockstar Games Newswire
items.summary: The first of two delays: Grand Theft Auto VI moved from 2025 to May 26, 2026.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Announced
items.description: Rockstar Games announced Grand Theft Auto VI alongside its first trailer, confirming the fictional state of Leonida, a return to Vice City, and a launch on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. The release window given at announcement was 2025; it has since been revised twice and is now November 19, 2026.
items.author: Rockstar Games Newswire
items.summary: The original announcement of Grand Theft Auto VI, confirming Leonida, Vice City, and PS5 / Xbox Series X|S.
